sections.title: The last few pieces
sections.content: garázs ("garage"), pince ("cellar, basement"), and mosogató ("kitchen sink") round out the picture of a whole building, not just one room. All three just take -ban/-ben like any other room.

items.spanish: A házban van garázs és pince is.
items.english: There's a garage and a cellar too in the building.
There's a new sink in the kitchen.

sections.content: is ("also, too") from A1 is doing real work here — garázs és pince is doesn't just list two things, it marks the second as a nice bonus on top of the first.
